Read about our commitment to Belonging at Snap We believe in building innovative and inclusive products for our global community, finding the best talent anywhere, and cultivating an environment where everyone belongs. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) at Snap bring together a community of individuals who share similar aspect(s) of their identities, creating engaging and safe spaces for identifying team members and allies, and a shared sense of belonging. ERGs offer opportunities for team members to empower and support each other, promote empathy, celebrate the community and share resources. Ultimately, ERGs are critical to enhancing innovation and creativity across our teams, enabling team members to enhance their skills, expand their networks, and show up as their true selves. SnapAbility supports a community of people who identify as, or are guardians for, a person with a disability across the spectrum of different mental and physical abilities, and neurodiversity. SnapAsia is a community for those from Asian countries and the Pacific Islands. SnapFamilia empowers and celebrates the diversity of Hispanic and Latiné communities. SnapHabibi is a community for those of Arab heritage, and from the MENA region at Snap. SnapNoir brings together and celebrates the diversity of the African diaspora. SnapParents supports all parents, guardians, and caregivers at Snap. SnapPride celebrates the diversity of gender identity, gender expression, and sexual orientation. SnapShalom is dedicated to celebrating Jewish ethnic diversity, culture, and faith. SnapVets supports and empowers Snap's military veterans and their families. SnapWomen brings together and empowers women at Snap.
